title: The Cantor's Request
text: For a whole sol the Choir's Cantor has been broadcasting one packet, over and over, in our own format: a request for power to its dead tower.

choices.label: Lend them power
choices.reply: A cable to the pylon. Its glow steadies. The loop of tenders speeds up, very slightly.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.reply: The packet stops. Then it starts again, slower.

choices.label: Take the tower apart for study
choices.reply: The drones strip the pylon's isotope cells. The tenders stop walking and watch.
